title: Uwa language - Wikipedia
text: The Uwa language, Uw Cuwa, commonly known as Tunebo, is a Chibchan language spoken by between 1,800 and 3,600 of the Uwa people of Colombia, out of a total population of about 7,000.

title: Chibchan languages - Wikipedia
text: The Chibchan languages (also known as Chibchano) are a language family indigenous to the Isthmo-Colombian Area, a geo-cultural region extending from Mosquitia in eastern Central America to northern Colombia, and encompassing parts of Costa Rica and Panama.

title: Tunebo, Angosturas Language (TND) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status ...
text: Angosturas Tunebo is an endangered indigenous language of Colombia. It belongs to the Chibchan language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by the elderly only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
